chapter_outcomes: Write simple connected texts (e.g. email messages, articles) on familiar topics (e.g. plans and arrangements, likes and dislikes, family, home environment, hobbies and interests, education, work and travel)
Describe past events and experiences, opinions, hopes and ambitions and give brief reasons for opinions and plans
Communicate with reasonable accuracy, using a range of structures, time frames and vocabulary relevant to the given situation
Use simple connectors (e.g. and, but, because, then) to link a series of shorter discrete elements into a connected sequence of points
